polls.question: Whether the Government should introduce a wealth tax on individuals with net assets (property, financial assets and luxury items) above 1 million euro who also have an annual income above 100,000 euro; 82% agreed strongly or slightly
polls.question_original: Do you agree or disagree that the Government should introduce a wealth tax on individuals who have net assets (including property, financial assets and luxury items) which are valued at more than one million euro and who have an annual individual income of more than a hundred thousand euro?
